Use case: identity-preserve. Image1 is the immediately previous RUN SW frame07 of this red fire-talisman boy. Make the next independently drawn frame08, the SECOND posture at the SAME under-hip RIGHT-foot ground position. Images2–3 lock identity; image4 locks painting style; image5 supplies only knee/ankle loading mechanics.
Keep image1's camera, physical head size and shoe placement. The RIGHT/far supporting shoe stays FLAT beneath the pelvis at the same ground position, facing lower-left SW. Now absorb weight through its connected right hip, knee and ankle: bend the supporting knee a little more, lean the shin over the ankle, and lower the pelvis/belly and chest a modest but clearly visible amount. This should be a distinct settled weight-bearing pose, not the same drawing copied. The LEFT/near free leg remains OFF the ground, knee folding closer to the body and heel rising slightly behind.
Keep the right knee, ankle and toe in the same sagittal movement direction, with no outward foot turn. Keep the complete LEFT bell arm forward and RIGHT five-card fan arm behind; allow tiny natural elbow/cloth follow-through, but never swap hands or add a limb. Do not stretch, shrink, zoom, or translate the whole figure. No painted ground/shadow/effects. Full square transparent RGBA sprite, native>=1024.
